title: Iki starter (iki/v1)
description: A starter (ADR 0303): how a project's Admin chooses one type's review procedure and gives the lab roles it needs. It names the procedure and the flows the project may choose; who must be different people, the roles each flow needs and its states are read from the procedure.

apiVersion.description: The spec version this manifest follows.

name.description: The starter's name in snake_case. Elsewhere it is `plugin.name`, such as `iki/proteomics.proteomics_search_review`.

version.description: Its release, as a semantic version such as `1.0.0`: what a project's Admin previews and applies.

governs.description: The reviewed type whose new records it pins: one `pinned: create` or `opens: true`, its plugin's own or a dependency's (`namespace/plugin.Type`). Records pinned by it follow it, and the procedure must fit each of them too.

procedure.description: The procedure it applies, as `plugin.name@version`, such as `iki/core.result_review@1`.

flows.description: The procedure's flows a project may choose, in the order they're offered.

suggested.description: The flow setup shows chosen at first (ADR 0302). Never applied by itself.

summaries.description: What a flow asks of people for this work, where the procedure's own summary says it less well.

slots.description: For the slots its flows use: the least project role someone playing it needs, and the lab role that plays it, if not the `iki/lab_roles` role of its name (ADR 0304).

minimum.description: The least project role a member needs to play it: `viewer` (who signs and reviews) or `editor` (who records). Defaults to `viewer`.

role.description: The lab role that plays it, qualified: `acme/qms.second_reviewer`.
